children.title: Evaluator Stress Testing for Objective Alignment and Proxy Detection

detail.title: Evaluator Stress Testing for Objective Alignment and Proxy Detection
detail.summary: The Evaluator Stress Test (EST) provides an invariance-based framework to distinguish exploitable proxy sensitivities from genuine content improvements, mitigating reward hacking and evaluator gaming.
detail.reason: Synthesizing evidence from the collected study on Evaluator Stress Testing to address proxy optimization and objective alignment.

children.title: Evaluator Stress Testing and Occupancy-Based Objective Alignment

detail.title: Evaluator Stress Testing and Occupancy-Based Objective Alignment
detail.summary: By integrating occupancy frequency formulations with invariance-based stress testing, autonomous systems can systematically identify and mitigate reward misspecification and proxy exploitation.
detail.reason: Revising nb-coc-01 with newly incorporated evidence on occupancy frequencies and reward misspecification.

children.title: Robust Proxy Optimization and Evaluator Alignment

detail.title: Robust Proxy Optimization and Evaluator Alignment
detail.summary: By formulating reward hacking as a robust policy optimization problem over the space of correlated proxy rewards, autonomous systems can obtain worst-case performance guarantees.
detail.reason: Incorporating new findings on robust policy optimization and r-correlated proxy rewards into notebook nb-coc-01.
